readme:
# Craigslist Housing and For Sale Scraper

Search Craigslist by area and category and get one record per posting: title, price, neighborhood, city, coordinates, bedrooms, bathrooms, property type and the posting link. Works for apartments, rooms, sublets, houses, real estate for sale and the for-sale categories such as furniture, electronics and cars. No login and no API key are needed.

Related: for job listings use the [Craigslist jobs scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/craigslist-jobs-scraper).

## What you get

- One record per posting for each area and category you give.
- Several areas and categories in one run. A posting found twice is returned once.
- Craigslist shows about 350 postings per search and has no second page. To reach more, the actor searches in price bands when a page is full, and you can add more areas.
- Optional search words and a price range.
- Postings are listed as the site shows them, newest first.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Listings already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/craigslist-housing-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `craigslist-housing-scraper` to list apartments for rent in sfbay and newyork under 3000 dollars, and show the cheapest 20 with their neighborhood."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `posting_id` | `"gwmgWr7MCEcA1BxVkHkqKG"` |
| `url` | `"https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/concord-apartment-homes-tailored-to/gwmgWr7MCEcA1BxVkHkqKG"` |
| `title` | `"Apartment Homes tailored to your highest standards."` |
| `price`, `price_text`, `currency` | `1965`, `"$1,965"`, `"USD"` |
| `location` | `"concord / pleasant hill / martinez"` (the neighborhood text on the card) |
| `city`, `region` | `"Concord"`, `"CA"` |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | `37.9575`, `-121.9750` |
| `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `sqft` | `1`, `1`, `750` (when shown) |
| `property_type` | `"Apartment"` or `"House"` |
| `area`, `category`, `query` | The area, category code and search words used |
| `price_band` | The price band of the search when the actor split a full page |
| `rank`, `search_url` | Position on its search page and the search page address |
| `scraped_at` | `"2026-11-07T08:00:00Z"` |

Fields that the page does not show for a posting are returned empty (null).

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Listing scraped (`listing-result`) | $0.0015 per listing ($1.50 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved listing. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `areas` | string[] | Craigslist areas by their site name, such as `sfbay`, `newyork`, `chicago`, `losangeles`. A full Craigslist address is read as well. | `sfbay` when empty |
| `categories` | string[] | Category codes: `apa` apartments, `roo` rooms, `sub` sublets, `hou` housing wanted, `rea` real estate for sale, `vac` vacation rentals, `off` office, `prk` parking, `hhh` all housing, `sss` all for sale, `cta` cars and trucks, `fua` furniture, `ela` electronics and the other codes shown in the input form. | `apa` when empty |
| `query` | string | Only postings that match these words. | all postings |
| `minPrice`, `maxPrice` | integer | Price range. 0 means no limit. | no limit |
| `splitPriceBands` | boolean | When a search page is full, search again in price bands to reach more postings. | `true` |
| `maxItems` | integer | Most listings to return across all searches. 0 uses 100. | `100` |
| `maxItemsPerArea` | integer | Most listings for each area, so that one area cannot use up the limit. 0 means no limit per area. | `0` |
| `maxRequests` | integer | Most search pages to read in one run. 0 uses 100. | `100` |

An unknown category code stops the run with a message that lists the allowed codes. An empty input runs a small default: apartments in sfbay, up to 100 listings.

## Usage examples

### Apartments in two areas

```json
{
  "areas": ["sfbay", "newyork"],
  "categories": ["apa"],
  "maxItems": 100,
  "maxItemsPerArea": 60
}
```

### Many apartments in one area, using price bands

```json
{
  "areas": ["chicago"],
  "categories": ["apa"],
  "minPrice": 500,
  "maxPrice": 6000,
  "splitPriceBands": true,
  "maxItems": 1000
}
```

### Used furniture with search words

```json
{
  "areas": ["losangeles"],
  "categories": ["fua"],
  "query": "sofa",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

## Output

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

Sample record:

```json
{
  "posting_id": "gwmgWr7MCEcA1BxVkHkqKG",
  "url": "https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/concord-apartment-homes-tailored-to/gwmgWr7MCEcA1BxVkHkqKG",
  "title": "Apartment Homes tailored to your highest standards.",
  "price": 1965,
  "price_text": "$1,965",
  "currency": "USD",
  "location": "concord / pleasant hill / martinez",
  "city": "Concord",
  "region": "CA",
  "latitude": 37.9574988,
  "longitude": -121.9749934,
  "bedrooms": 1,
  "bathrooms": 1,
  "sqft": null,
  "property_type": "Apartment",
  "area": "sfbay",
  "category": "apa",
  "query": null,
  "price_band": null,
  "rank": 1,
  "search_url": "https://sfbay.craigslist.org/search/apa",
  "scraped_at": "2026-11-07T08:00:00Z"
}
```

## Limitations

- Only search pages are read. Posting pages are not opened, so the description, the posting date, the photos and the contact details are not collected.
- Craigslist shows about 350 postings per search and has no second page. Price bands and more areas are the ways to get more. Postings without a price are only found by the search without a price band.
- Coordinates, bedrooms and bathrooms come from the page's own data and are missing for some postings. Many for-sale postings have no coordinates.
- For-sale categories such as `sss`, `cta`, `fua` and `ela` return item rows: title, price, location and link. The housing fields (bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet, property type, city and coordinates) stay empty for those rows.
- The currency is guessed from the price symbol and the area. A dollar price in a Canadian area is reported as CAD.
- The number of postings changes while the run reads the pages, so two runs of the same input can differ.
- If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged.

## FAQ

**Which pages does it read?**
The search pages of the Craigslist area you name, for example sfbay.craigslist.org/search/apa. It does not open posting pages.

**How do I get more than 350 postings for one area?**
Keep `splitPriceBands` on and raise `maxItems`. When a search page is full, the actor searches again in price bands. You can also add areas.

**What happens when a posting shows up twice?**
It is returned once.

**What does a run cost?**
The start price plus the price per listing, see the pricing table.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many listings were delivered. If nothing matched, the run ends normally and says so. If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged.
